brands.note: Which brand mark a row shows. Every id names a vendored lockup in packages/assets/src/icons/combine/; scripts/build/build.mjs fails the build on an id that is not there. This is presentation data, kept out of the bundle like the rest of this document, and it is separate from the copy rules above: a vendor's mark and a vendor's description line change for different reasons. `providers` is deliberately empty: a model no rule claims draws **no** lockup rather than its provider's, because the reseller's own lockup on a model it did not make reads as a wrong answer rather than a missing one. `models` is an ordered, anchored rule list resolved against the model's id and then its display name (D79), exactly like `families` and with the same discipline: first match wins, so a broad rule must sit below the narrow ones and every rule must name its vendor (`step` cannot match `step-3.7-flash` by accident only if no earlier rule already claimed it). A brand with no lockup renders the label without a mark.

models.note: This rule must precede Amazon Nova: the whole SenseNova name is one vendor, with `nova` never starting its own segment.

Claude rows draw Claude's own lockup, not the parent Anthropic one: the label names the model line, and a wordmark has to match the word it stands in for — the same reason Grok rows draw Grok's rather than xAI's. Excluding distilled ids keeps third-party base models distilled from Claude (such as Gemma or Qwen variants) under their own vendor mark.
Nano Banana is a Gemini image model with its own identity in the catalog, so it draws its own lockup rather than the Gemini one.
Gemma is Google's open model line, so it draws its own lockup rather than the parent Google one — the same reason Claude and Grok do.
A Gemini row shows the model line's mark; the provider group header above it shows Google's, because providers resolve from `providers` and never from here.

The id can carry the serving provider's namespace (`cn:k3`, `moonshot/k3`, `morph-kimik3`), so the segment start accepts any character outside a letter or a digit while leaving unrelated words such as `kimiko` and `mk3` unclaimed. A version number belongs to the name (`k3.1`, `k3p1`), and `k3-256k` still ends on its hyphen.

Short aliases (`m2`, `m3`, `cn:m3`, `openrouter/m3`, `m2-her`) only start at the id or after a provider namespace separator (`:` or `/`), leaving hyphenated third-party ids such as `bge-m3`, `humain-m3-preview` and `baichuan-m2-32b` unclaimed.
Grok is the model line, xAI the company: a Grok row shows Grok's own mark, while the provider group header above it still shows xAI's, because providers resolve from `providers` and never from here.

The id can carry the serving provider's namespace (`cn:hy3`, `openrouter/hy3`), so the segment start accepts any character outside a letter or a digit. Requiring `hy` to start a segment is what leaves `shy-mt2` unclaimed.
The vendor name has to start a segment and end one: unanchored, this rule claims `sensenova-6.8-flash-lite` for Amazon and lands that lockup in the middle of the name.

Beam is Reflection's own line, so its rows draw the vendor's lockup — whose word is the vendor's, and the catalog's own name never spells it (`Beam Free · OpenCode Go`), so the label leads with the lockup instead of replacing a word in it. Word boundaries keep unrelated words containing `beam` unclaimed.
Anchored to a version digit or explicit prefix so English words containing `ling` (such as `inkling`) stay unclaimed.
Sits after Meta (`muse-spark`) and OpenAI (`codex-spark`) and explicitly excludes them so iFlytek Spark never claims either.

lockups.note: Per-brand overrides for the vendored lockup, applied by scripts/data/fetch-lobe-combines.py. `word` is the word the lockup stands in for inside a model name (it must match how the catalog spells it, which is not always Lobe's TITLE), `mark` and `text` name the Lobe icons the two halves are taken from (so a model line can wear its own mark with its parent's wordmark), `keep` crops a wordmark to a fraction of its ink width (GLM-V's "-V" is not part of the name), and `tint` is the brand colour a hand-provided mark wears on the ivory canvas, where a fetched mark carries Lobe's own.

families.note: Every mention of the line reads the same boundary as the lockup rule: unanchored, this rule gives `sensenova-6.8-flash-lite` Amazon Nova's description.

text.zh: 多模态通用模型，支持文本、图像与视频输入。
text.en: Multimodal models supporting text, image and video input.

text.zh: 结合实时网络搜索作答并附引用，覆盖快速问答到深度研究。
text.en: Grounded in live web search with citations, from quick answers to deep research.

text.zh: 混合 Mamba-Transformer MoE 开放权重系列，面向长上下文推理与智能体任务。
text.en: Hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE open-weight models for long-context reasoning and agents.

text.zh: 开放权重原生多模态 MoE 系列，支持文本、图像与音频长上下文理解。
text.en: Open-weight native multimodal MoE supporting text, image and audio over long contexts.

text.zh: 高智效比 MoE 通用与多模态系列，擅长复杂推理与高频智能体工作流。
text.en: High-efficiency MoE general and multimodal models for complex reasoning and frequent agent workflows.

text.zh: 多智能体协同编排模型，动态调度思考、执行与验证角色求解复杂任务。
text.en: Multi-agent orchestration model coordinating thinker, worker and verifier roles on hard tasks.

text.zh: 深度扩展架构高性价比模型，面向多语言通用对话与企业任务。
text.en: Depth-upscaled, cost-efficient models for multilingual chat and enterprise tasks.

text.zh: 液态基础架构轻量模型，主打端侧部署、低延迟推理与多模态理解。
text.en: Compact liquid foundation models built for edge deployment, low latency and multimodality.

text.zh: Mamba-Transformer 混合架构企业模型，擅长长上下文文档分析与吞吐优化。
text.en: Hybrid Mamba-Transformer enterprise models built for long-context analysis and high throughput.

text.zh: 面向中文理解、多模态交互、编程与工具调用的通用与智能体系列。
text.en: General and agentic models for Chinese understanding, multimodality, coding and tool calling.

text.zh: 企业合规导向的开放权重系列，面向代码生成、结构化任务与私有化部署。
text.en: Enterprise-focused open-weight models for code generation, structured tasks and self-hosting.

text.zh: 大规模稀疏 MoE 开放权重模型，支持超长上下文推理与行业应用。
text.en: Large sparse MoE open-weight models supporting long-context reasoning and enterprise tasks.

text.zh: 经沙盒强化学习训练的代码智能体系列，擅长仓库级软件工程任务。
text.en: Sandbox RL-trained coding agent models built for repository-level software engineering.

text.zh: 响应快、成本低，适合轻量或高频任务。
text.en: Fast and low-cost, for lightweight or high-frequency tasks.

text.zh: 面向复杂或质量优先的任务，能力更强、成本更高。
text.en: For complex, quality-first work with higher capability and cost.

tiers.note: MoE active-parameter suffix (`a95b`, `a23b`); tried before the dense rule so the active count is not mistaken for a total.

text.zh: MoE 架构，单位成本低于同规模稠密模型。
text.en: Mixture-of-experts model costing less to serve than a dense model of its size.

tiers.note: Bounded to compact sizes up to 32B and anchored to a segment start so `a95b`, `72b` and `405b` are not described as compact low-cost models.

text.zh: 中小规模参数版本，推理成本低、易于私有化部署。
text.en: Compact parameter size with low serving cost and easy self-hosting.
